title: Household ID
              description: >-
                A stable shared identifier for owners that belong to the same
                household (same last name and address). It is assigned when an
                owner is created with 'sharesHousehold' true and is identical for
                every owner in that household.
              type: string
              example: 'HH-3F2A1B9C4D5E'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                The owner's derived duplicate-detection key, formatted
                '<normalizedTelephone>|<email>|<householdId>' where the email and
                household id segments are empty when absent. Two owners are
                treated as duplicates only when their whole identity keys match.
              type: string
              example: '+61412345678||HH-3F2A1B9C4D5E'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of owners that already existed, at the time this owner
                was created, sharing the same first and last name (compared
                case-insensitively). Excludes the owner itself.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: >-
                The owner's membership points, starting at 0. Gains 2 when an
                email is present, 1 when the owner has no namesakes
                (namesakeCount is 0), 2 for a household of 3 or more, and 3 when
                the owner's tenure spans at least one elapsed fiscal year (the
                registration date's fiscal year is earlier than the current
                fiscal year).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                The owner's membership level, a number from 1 to 4 derived from
                the owner's membership points: 1 for 0-1 points, 2 for 2-3, 3
                for 4-5, and 4 for 6 or more.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-
                Whether the owner was created on a day that had already reached
                the bulk-signup threshold: true when more than 80 owners had
                already been created for the owner's registration date at the
                time this owner was created, otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The owner's locality, the REGION segment of the owner's customer
                code (the region-and-hash identity '<REGION>-<HASH8>'). 'UNKNOWN'
                when no region could be resolved.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: >-
                The owner's IANA timezone name, derived from the owner's
                locality/region via the fixed region-to-timezone table:
                NSW->Australia/Sydney, VIC->Australia/Melbourne,
                QLD->Australia/Brisbane. Absent when no region could be
                resolved.
              type: string
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                The owner's preferred contact channel, derived on read: 'EMAIL'
                when an email address is present, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: >-
                The owner's stored E.164 telephone formatted for humans: the
                country code, a space, then the national digits grouped in
                threes (e.g. '+61 412 345 678'). The raw 'telephone' field stays
                in E.164 form.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: >-
                The owner's age band, derived from the birth date when present:
                'MINOR' when under 18, 'ADULT' from 18 to 64, and 'SENIOR' at 65
                or older, computed as the owner's age on the registration date.
                Absent when no birth date was supplied.
              type: string
              enum:
                - MINOR
                - ADULT
                - SENIOR
              example: 'ADULT'
              readOnly: true
            checkDigit:
              title: Check digit
              description: >-

content.text:
All tests pass with a clean build. Here's a summary of what I implemented.

## Change: household-capped membership level

**Spec:** A new owner's `membershipLevel` cannot exceed one above the current maximum `membershipLevel` among their household members; the capped level is returned. With no existing household member, no cap applies.

### What I found
`membershipLevel` is a read-time derived field (`OwnerMapper.membershipLevel`) computed from `membershipPoints`. The cap depends on household members' levels at creation time, so — like the existing `namesakeCount`/`householdSize` snapshots — it must be captured at creation and persisted.

The new acceptance test also creates **two owners in the same household** (same last name + postcode) with *different* telephones and expects both to succeed. The old `rejectDuplicateIdentity` rejected any second owner sharing a `householdId` with a 409, contradicting the documented identity-key semantics (openapi: *"Two owners are treated as duplicates only when their whole identity keys match"*).

### Edits
1. **`Owner.java`** — added a persisted `membershipLevelCap` field (nullable) with accessors.
2. **Schema files** (h2, hsqldb, mysql, postgres) — added the `membership_level_cap` column so the snapshot survives a reload (tests run on hsqldb with `ddl-auto=none`, and every read re-derives the level).
3. **`OwnerMapper.membershipLevel`** — after deriving the 1–4 level, caps it: `min(level, cap)` when a cap is present; unchanged otherwise. Stays within the openapi `[1,4]` bounds.
4. **`OwnerRestControllerV1`**:
   - `rejectDuplicateIdentity` now compares the full identity key (`telephone|email|householdId`, reusing `OwnerMapper.identityKey`) instead of `householdId` alone — so same-household owners differing in telephone/email are admitted as additional members, matching the documented spec.
   - Added `membershipLevelCap(householdId)` (one above the highest effective level among existing non-deleted household members, or `null` when none) and snapshot it onto the owner at creation.

### Verification
- `coreCapsLevelByHousehold`: both owners created (levels 1 and 2), `lb ≤ la + 1` holds.
- Full suite: **BUILD SUCCESS**, 1 test, 0 failures.
